decision.rationale: The UBC-branded Working Papers in Linguistics institutional archive provides public linguistic conference volumes, papers, and contributor guidance. Its homepage identifies UBCWPL publishing in Vancouver and documents conferences in multiple locations; one Okanagan-hosted conference does not make the archive Okanagan-exclusive. Research is the default, with homepage-evidenced academic qualifying papers and practical contributor/citation guidance routed separately. No matching published hostname or saved first policy was found.

rules.rationale: Observed navigation explicitly separates author, reviewer, publication, and citation instructions from the research volumes.
The homepage identifies UBC Qualifying Papers as a distinct academic section.
The homepage lists linguistic conference volumes and the Kinkade research archive as publication collections.

fallback.rationale: UBCWPL is an institutional archive of linguistic research papers and conference proceedings.
